meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 用户给一段文字后,Claude 会把它做成一部“无脸解说视频”:没有实拍或截图,每幕画面都是按场景设计的排版、图形或图表。Claude 会按固定步骤搭建项目、写简报、选设计系统、做分镜和旁白脚本、逐帧生成画面,最终渲染成 mp4 视频。
howto.when: 当用户给出文章、笔记或主题,要求做成解说类视频(如概念拆解、教程、盘点等),且不是网站/产品宣传片时触发。意图不明确则先转 /hyperframes 判断。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利攒钱的文章做成一个无脸解说视频。
say.note: 这会启动项目搭建和简报确认,再进入分镜和渲染流程。

say.text: 帮我做一个“什么是量子纠缠”的概念讲解视频,不要实拍,用图形动画。
say.note: 触发概念拆解视频流程,自动选择设计系统并生成分镜。

say.text: 把这篇文章的要点做成一个图文动画的操作指南视频,不露脸。
say.note: 按教程/清单结构规划分镜,然后生成帧和视频。

howto.what_en: Turns text into a faceless explainer video (no capture; visuals invented per scene). Runs a pipeline: setup, brief, design system, storyboard/script, audio, frames, then renders mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user asks to turn text into a faceless explainer video (not a website/product promo), e.g., concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. If unclear, defers to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Starts setup and brief, then storyboarding.

say_en.text: Explain quantum entanglement as a faceless concept video with graphics.
say_en.note: Triggers concept-breakdown flow and design pick.

say_en.text: Turn this article's points into a faceless how-to video with charts and text.
say_en.note: Triggers how-to flow and storyboards from text.
